findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe ctypes usage
 * @description Checking for potentially unsafe ctypes usage that could lead to memory corruption or arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-ctypes
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-119
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("ctypes").getMember([
    "cdll", "windll", "oledll", "pythonapi", 
    "c_void_p", "c_char_p", "c_wchar_p", "c_buffer",
    "cast", "pointer", "POINTER", "create_string_buffer",
    "create_unicode_buffer", "string_at", "wstring_at"
  ]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe ctypes usage that could lead to memory corruption or arbitrary code execution."
